description: Australian Broadband Guarantee is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts. The Australian Broadband Guarantee (ABG) was an Australian Government initiative designed to help residential and small business premises access high-quality broadband services regardless of where they were located. The program targeted premises unable to access commercial metro-comparable services, particularly those living in remote parts of Australia. Coverage: Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts. Its tags are abg, australianbroadbandguarantee, broadband, dbcde. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, KML, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
